{{Quote|As you know, a few years ago I stepped down as head of New Republic Council Research to take this teaching position, but I still have some ties to the government.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="Field Work">{{WEGCite|story=Field Work|book=The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''New Republic Council Research''' was an organization that undertook research for the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] was its [[Director/Legends|director]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].
